rows.note: Use this in casual speech for a demonstrated record or performance with no mistakes, rather than an abstract claim of inherent infallibility.

example.english: The team's infallibility this season is truly impressive.
example.traditional: 呢隊波今季場場都冇甩漏，真係零失誤。
example.jyutping: ne1 deoi6 bo1 gam1 gwai3 coeng4 coeng4 dou1 mou5 lat1 lau6 zan1 hai6 ling4 sat1 ng6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose formal noun for the abstract property of never being wrong, especially in academic or religious writing.

example.english: The infallibility of this theory still needs to be verified by the academic community.
example.traditional: 呢套理論嘅無謬性，仲有待學術界驗證。
example.jyutping: nei1 tou3 lei5 leon6 ge3 mou4 mau6 sing3 zung6 jau5 doi6 hok6 seot6 gaai3 jim6 zing3
